_doc: Region recipe: Lumen Depths (Nerit's homeland). Data only. Schema: design/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Source: bible section 24. Light is food, language, navigation and territory; darkness can mean privacy, rest, protection, mourning, intimacy.
name: The Lumen Depths
summary: A subterranean world of vertical oceans, mineral forests, hollow mountains and ceilings so distant they read as night skies. Bioluminescent colonies form living constellations whose movement marks season, migration and danger.

layers.hazard: unseen drops, sleepers in the dark

surfaces.desc: Flat crystalline ledges; ring when struck.
Soft silt that lights where it is disturbed.
Dark wet stone, easy to slip on.
Loose plates of mineral; loud underfoot.

ground.relief: vertical shafts, long ledges, hanging walkways; water layers are walked by bridge or swum

sky.ceiling: a far dome with living constellations

props.note: Pulsing colonies. Their rhythm is language. Do not shine a lamp on them.
Tall crystal columns; reflect and bend light.
Woven rope and silk, strung across shafts.
A dark hollow where something rests. Light disturbs it.
A sealed stone door with a pulse-lock. Closed is still working.

flora: lantern kelp, glass bloom, bell-moss, crystal fern (opens only under certain color frequencies)

creatures.name: Pulse Swarm
creatures.desc: A cloud of tiny emitters that communicate by pulse.
creatures.behavior: Mimics the light it sees. Shining a lamp at it triggers a defensive flash.

creatures.name: Glass Eel
creatures.desc: A transparent eel that hunts illumination.

creatures.name: Bell Drifter
creatures.desc: Soft-bodied drifters that graze on glow-silt.
creatures.behavior: Passive. Light-sensitive; hides from bright beams.

creatures.name: Spire Sleeper
creatures.desc: A heavy, slow animal that sleeps in the dark and wakes angry when lit.
creatures.behavior: Sleeps. If lit, wakes and charges. If left alone, ignores travelers.

uses.ecology: digs out new dens that become habitat

layers.dark: almost nothing; a single held tone

music.stinger_on_event: a bell that decays into silence

world_states.label: Extraction
world_states.effect: Dominion survey lamps flood the forest layer; Pulse Swarms are agitated.

world_states.label: Disease
world_states.effect: A pale blight dims the colonies. Light sources are scarcer; darkness is deeper.

world_states.label: Migration
world_states.effect: The constellations move. Drifters and eels shift layers; routes flip.

bondable_here.hook: Their homeland. Tests of when not to turn the light on live here.
A sealed vault door: a threshold to leave closed.

descent_events.title: The den in the dark
descent_events.text: A hollow in the wet basalt. Something large breathes inside. A single lamp would reveal it, and the survey data you need would be on the lamp's first frame.

choices.label: Leave the lamp off. Note the den from its breathing.
choices.result: You walk past without a sound. Nerit's glow dims, politely, to match.

choices.label: Light the den and take the data.
choices.result: The sleeper wakes. The lamp is on it. The data is perfect and the sleeper is furious.

choices.label: Promise Nerit you will not light it while it sleeps.
choices.result: Nerit holds the promise like a small lantern.

descent_events.title: The constellations move
descent_events.text: The glow colonies overhead slide into a new shape. Below, drifters rise and eels sink to meet them. The path you planned now runs under a hungry mouth.

choices.label: Follow the drifters. They know the safe layer.
choices.result: They lead you around the eels' stretch of water, slowly.

choices.label: Take the old path before the migration finishes.
choices.result: You make it. A drifter does not.

choices.label: Chart the new shape for Mara and wait.
choices.result: The chart is the first of its kind. The wait is long and the log is full.

descent_events.title: Survey lamps in the crystal forest
descent_events.text: A Dominion lamp rig floods the mineral forest with white light. Pulse Swarms flash in alarm. Somewhere beyond the glare, a Survey Chief is counting yield.

choices.label: Cut the rig's power.
choices.result: The swarm calms. The chief logs a fault.

choices.label: Photograph the rig inside a protected colony.
choices.result: The evidence will hold in front of the Authority.

choices.label: Take the survey data and go.
choices.result: The Dominion is pleased. The colony is not.

descent_events.title: A sealed door in the stone
descent_events.text: A sealed stone door, older than the paths around it. A pulse-lock beats faintly behind it. Pharilux looks at it and then at you. 'Closed,' he says, 'is still working.'

choices.label: Leave it sealed.
choices.result: You mark it on the map as a place you did not go. Pharilux's beacon rests on you a little longer.

choices.label: Ask him where it leads, and why he cares.
choices.result: He says nothing. The beacon turns away.

choices.label: Pry it open.
choices.result: The lock sings once. The sound goes a very long way.

descent_events.title: A drifter in the glare
descent_events.text: A Bell Drifter has been caught by a lamp left on a ledge and is rising toward the heat of it. It is turning slowly, like it is dreaming.

choices.label: Put the lamp out and guide it down.
choices.result: It sinks into the dark and, after a while, glows a little.

choices.label: Scan it while it is lit.
choices.result: The scan is clean. The drifter does not return to the dark for an hour.

descent_events.title: A marker half sunk in the silt
descent_events.text: A stone marker, partly submerged in glow-silt, bears the same symbols as the one in the Red Reaches. Here they are inlaid with mineral that only shows in the dark.

choices.label: Read it by darkness.
choices.result: Nerit drops the lamp and the marks light up. It is a warning about what the water remembers.

choices.label: Read it by lamp.
choices.result: The marks vanish under the glare. You copy what you can.

descent_events.title: The den you lit
descent_events.text: You come back to a den you once lit. The sleeper is gone. A pale scar of light is still on the wall. Nerit stands beside it without speaking.

choices.label: Cover the scar with silt until it dims.
choices.result: Nerit lets the dark settle back. 'It was not the light,' they say. 'It was the not-asking.'

descent_events.title: The door you forced
descent_events.text: The vault door you forced still hangs ajar. Its pulse has changed. Pharilux waits beside it with his lantern low.

choices.label: Close it as well as you can and say nothing about it.
choices.result: The pulse steadies. Pharilux's lantern lifts, a little.
